‍

Investigation and sanctions for violations of the safe transaction policy

‍

‍

‍

1. A: All products will be suspended from sale for 5 days.

‍

1-1. Baguette Shoulder Bag

- Violation: Design theft

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to intellectual property rights infringement (cited by the Intellectual Property Protection Committee), 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa and 29CM products will be suspended for 5 days from February 20, 2025.

‍

2. B: All products will be sold for 5 days.

‍

2-1. Crumble Derby Shoes

- Violation: Design theft

- Violation: 1 violation of the Safe Transaction Policy due to intellectual property rights infringement (cited by the Intellectual Property Protection Committee), 40 penalty points awarded

- Sanctions: Sales of all Musinsa products will be suspended for 5 days starting February 20, 2025.

‍

‍

February 20, 2025

‍

对违反安全交易政策的行为进行调查和制裁

‍

‍

‍

1. A：所有产品将暂停销售5天。

‍

1-1. 法棍单肩包

违规行为：设计盗窃

- 违规：因侵犯知识产权违反安全交易政策1次（由知识产权保护委员会认定），扣除40分。

- 制裁：从 2025 年 2 月 20 日起，所有 Musinsa 和 29CM 产品的销售将暂停 5 天。

‍

2. B：所有产品将销售 5 天。

‍

2-1. 碎裂德比鞋

违规行为：设计盗窃

- 违规：因侵犯知识产权违反安全交易政策1次（由知识产权保护委员会认定），扣除40分。

- 制裁：自 2025 年 2 月 20 日起，暂停销售所有 Musinsa 产品 5 天。
